files.description: 16-page EHI Export and User Guide for SecureEMR+ (Denali 3.1). Covers single-patient and population-level export workflows, lists 43+ exportable data worksheets (clinical, billing, documents, administrative), describes export format (ZIP containing XLS, TXT, PDF, and CCD HTML/XML files), includes UI screenshots showing the CuresEHIExport role, Export Patient Data dialog, Configure Export Fields interface, and exported file structure. Only source of (b)(10) EHI export documentation for this product.
